_note: Durable investor profile and per-position policy. Kept OUTSIDE holdings/latest.json on purpose: the nightly snapshot is overwritten from the pasted Vanguard dashboard, which would wipe anything stored in it. The morning Routine reads this file alongside the snapshot.

what_this_means: Prefers earlier entries (VCP pivot, early Stage 2 breakout) over waiting for full confirmation.
Tolerates deeper drawdowns and higher volatility on trend-managed positions.
Comfortable with concentration; does not want size trimmed purely for diversification.
Does NOT mean abandoning stop discipline on trend-managed positions — only that the tolerance band is wider.

policies.trend: Default. Fully governed by STRATEGY.md — hold/trim/pyramid rules and the 50-day sell rule all apply.
policies.sitting: Long-term core hold the user has explicitly exempted from the sell rules. Report its condition for information, but NEVER raise it as a trim/sell/replace action item, and do not count it as a rule violation. Pyramiding rules still apply if the user asks about adding.

QQQM.note: Long-held legacy position, user is deliberately sitting on it. User has stated he will not sell even if price loses the 50-day moving average. Do not flag for trim on RS, on a 50-day undercut, or on the VOO/QQQM relative-strength spread — that comparison was already raised and declined.
